_: Second real-trigger wiring of the Script-Event dispatcher (after story-manager-magictrigger.json's spell). A custom lever (ACTI, vanilla CaveLever01 model) carries MFSE_ActivatorTrigger; OnActivate -> MFStoryEventDispatch.Fire(kw, activator) -> the SM ScriptEvent root starts MFSE_LeverTarget with Activator=the actor who pulled it. No placement needed: spawn the lever in front of you with `player.placeatme XX000800` (XX = load order), then activate it. Distinct entry point, identical one-line dispatcher call — the reusable-trigger-library pattern.

activators.name: Forge Lever
activators._: Vanilla free-standing pull-bar mesh (GenPullBar01, verified present in Skyrim.esm — formid 026826) so it renders and stands on the ground when spawned. The payload is the attached MFSE_ActivatorTrigger script.

quests.name: Forge Lever Target
quests._: Started by the SM ScriptEvent root when MFSE_LeverKW fires. Activator alias pulls event ref1 (whoever pulled the lever — the player). Verify: pull the lever, then `sqv MFSE_LeverTarget` -> State Running, Activator alias filled.
